description: A single radar shape with a visible 0 to 100 value scale along the vertical axis.
overview: Uses `RadarChart` with `outerRadius="70%"`, a `PolarAngleAxis` on `skill`, a `PolarGrid`, and a `PolarRadiusAxis` with `angle={90}`, `domain={[0, 100]}`, `tickCount={5}` and `axisLine={false}`, whose ticks use the `fill-label-tertiary` class. One `Radar` plots `thisMonth` at `fillOpacity={0.3}`. `chartData` holds six `{ skill, thisMonth, lastMonth }` records. `chartConfig` colors `thisMonth` with `var(--green)` and `lastMonth` with `var(--gray)`. The tooltip uses `ChartTooltipContent` with `indicator="line"` and `cursor={false}`.
usage: Replace `chartData` with one record per axis, keeping a category key for `PolarAngleAxis dataKey` and a numeric key per series. Rename series in `chartConfig` and in the `var(--color-<key>)` references on each `Radar`. Set the `PolarRadiusAxis` `domain` to your scale and `tickCount` to the number of rings you want labeled; change `angle` to place the labels along a different spoke.
notes: A fixed `domain` keeps the scale stable when values change, so shapes remain comparable across datasets. `accessibilityLayer` is set on `RadarChart`, so the chart is focusable and arrow keys move between axes.
